name: Penrhiw Hotel
accommodation: B&B rooms and suites (including the Meadow Suite, Garden Room and Valley room) plus self-catering accommodation; exclusive-use hire available
suitableFor: Couples, small groups and those wanting a quiet retreat
beachAccess: Not stated; set in the Cathedral valley at St Davids
confirmedFeatures: Guest lounge, reading nooks, landscaped gardens and wildflower meadow, treatments, exclusive-use hire; dining at sister hotel Twr y Felin
overview: Penrhiw is a small hotel beside the Cathedral valley in St Davids, offering B&B rooms and suites alongside self-catering space, with gardens running down to a wildflower meadow. Evening dining is at its sister hotel, Twr y Felin, a short drive away. Whitesands is a short drive from St Davids.
surfTripFit: A quiet, comfortable base on the edge of St Davids for surfers who want gardens and peace after a day at Whitesands.
